extraction_chamber_guardian.description: Security construct. Designed to protect extraction chambers. Doesn't think—only follows programs.

moves.name: GRAPPLE
moves.description: Locks target in place for 1 turn.

player_strategy: Use Cipher's REDIRECT/protection tools to keep Kira safe.
Guard or heal through SWEEP pressure instead of spending every ATB turn on offense.
Conserve enough recovery resources for LOCKDOWN.

phases.trigger_description: At 150 HP, Guardian stops moving and enters stationary defensive position.
phases.behavior: Stationary. High defense but limited offensive options.
phases.phase_strategy: High damage output. LOCKDOWN reduces incoming damage but Guardian is stationary.

moves.name: LOCKDOWN DEFENSE
moves.description: Guardian takes 50% reduced damage. Cannot move or use physical attacks.

moves.name: ENERGY PULSE
moves.description: AOE magic attack. Reflects back 50% of damage taken.

moves.name: SYSTEM RESET
moves.description: Restores 20 HP. Can only use once per phase.

player_strategy: LOCKDOWN halves incoming damage; choose attack windows carefully.
Survive ENERGY PULSE pressure while waiting for the Resonance disruption window.
Use the disruption window for concentrated physical damage.

special_interactions.condition: Guardian enters LOCKDOWN for the first time while Kira is protected in the extraction chamber.
special_interactions.description: Kira reacts instinctively to the Guardian's LOCKDOWN. Her Resonance disrupts the defensive field for 2 turns.
special_interactions.effect: Guardian takes 2x damage during disruption. Kira suffers 15 recoil damage internally; her exact HP is not presented as an enemy-style bar.
special_interactions.consequence: Facility logs the anomaly. Narrative consequences are reserved for later content.

defeat_sequence.event: Guardian shuts down. Extraction chamber door opens.

difficulty_intent.expected_experience: An underprepared player may lose and should benefit from better item use, equipment, or a few additional levels.
rules: Failure should teach the player about SWEEP, LOCKDOWN, resource conservation, and timing.

developer_notes: All boss HP and phase thresholds are internal only. Never expose boss HP, percentage, or health bars in player-facing UI.
